description: Replication Data for: Auditing Flood Vulnerability Geo-Intelligence Workflow for Biases is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by DANS Data Station Social Sciences and Humanities. Dataset used in the flood vulnerability workflow discussed in the PhD thesis "Characterising housing stock vulnerability to floods by combining UAV, Mapillary and survey data - A case study for the Karonga district in Malawi" and subsequently used to audit the same workflow. Please see the README file for more details. Coverage: Malawi. The portal files it under the publisher DANS Data Station Social Sciences and Humanities. Its tags are Earth and Environmental Sciences. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is DANS Licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
